name: AppleFx
summary: Loud cartoony feedback on every screen: health bars over enemies, hit flashes, sparks and floating damage, a smoke puff and floating coins on a defeat, a bounce and sparkles when something is placed or levelled up, a camera shake when the base is hit, and every sound by role (public, checked sound effects).

needs.state: Workspace.AppleEnemies (Health, MaxHealth, Reward, LastHitBy, Defeated), Workspace.AppleDefenders (Owner, Level), ReplicatedStorage.AppleShot, ReplicatedStorage.AppleState (BaseHealth)
needs.config: optional AppleClientConfig.sounds = { click, open, error, cash, place, upgrade, levelup, countdown, wave, cleared, shoot, hit, defeat, base } (asset ids)
